fields.climate: tropical; marine, hot and humid, moderated by trade winds
fields.terrain: mostly low-lying coral atolls surrounded by extensive reefs
fields.hazards: typhoons can occur any time, but usually November to March; occasional tornadoes; low level of some of the islands make them sensitive to changes in sea level
fields.farm: coconuts, bananas, vegetables, taro, tropical fruits, pork, chicken, nuts, eggs, pork offal
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 58.9%, Kiribati Uniting Church 21.2%, Kiribati Protestant Church 8.4%, Church of Jesus Christ 5.6%, Seventh Day Adventist 2.1%, Baha'i 2.1%, other 1.7%
fields.legal: English common law supplemented by customary law
